Could we start with the writing program's perspective on this proposal?

transcript.text: I should share an important update. This week, I finalized the writing program's adopted pilot standard for AI writing-feedback platforms, which hasn't yet been added to the proposal packet. The standard permits the platform only for formative feedback, requires an instructor to review every generated suggestion before it is released to a student, and prohibits using the platform to assign or determine grades. These are the instructional requirements I believe should govern any pilot we approve.
